gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with Jaffe Lane running in an easterly direction continuing the line of Jaffe Road for a distance of 150 ft. where it meets the eastern boundary of M.L. 52 R.P. as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. R.H. 853D.

Road commencing at its junction with Jaffe Road running in a northerly direction continuing the line of Jaffe Lane for a distance of 120 ft. and then in a northwesterly direction for 150 ft. where it meets the north western boundary of M.L. 52 R.P. as shown coloured green on Drawing No. R.H. 853D.
